retrievalLimitations: The generic ON_CARD_PLAYED policy is a data-modeling interface, not a claim that the official rulebook defines a universal card-play trigger.
Every real-card listener still requires a separately traceable official card text and timing audit.
No PTCG Live behavior, Japanese, Asian, Pocket or community source is treated as international rules authority.
implementationLimits: The server emits the event only after a completed from-hand Basic Pokémon, Evolution, manual Energy or Trainer play reaches its final resulting zone.
Effect-mediated movement from deck, discard pile or another zone is not misclassified as a hand-play event.
Trigger ordering, source eligibility, hidden information, preflight and failures use the central server battle engine.
